pundit.name: Clint Dempsey
pundit.take: Bubba G's French squad gonna roast Ghost Pepper's Spain like it's a backyard barbecue. Look, France has been on fire, top of the pack alongside Gunner here, who must think he's got the secret sauce locked down. But man, Devin's still backin' his picks like they're La Liga all-stars, even after Spain got their wings clipped last round. Truth is, this duel in Arlington is set to be smokin' hot, but I'm callin' it now: Gunner's crew will sizzle while Devin's might just fizzle. Bubba G ain't leavin' Texas without some cowboy swagger, bet on it.
